title: RawCloud
description: L0 artifact — raw artifact scan with no interpretation. Entropy gate rejects low-variance inputs.
note: git_state/docs/entropy are required only of CODE-repo scans by convention (dw-ingest emits them); a domain adapter (sensor export, doc set, log stream) has no git state, so requiring them at schema level blocked the exact any-domain contract the release ships. The if/then below relaxes per-file requirements in distances mode, where entries carry only a path.

features.description: Domain-adapter channels: named numeric features on a fixed frame (all entries the same length). When present these replace the default [size, staleness, language] basis, so ANY domain — code, docs, logs, sensor exports — feeds the same pipeline.

feature_names.description: Channel names for the adapter feature frame, index-aligned with files[].features

distances.description: Optional precomputed pairwise distance matrix (row order = files order). Skips feature extraction; the decoy null check is omitted (and says so) since there is no feature basis to shuffle.

flags.description: Significance flags — the ONLY sanctioned significance channel; closed vocabulary pinned in driftwave.pin.json, enforced by dw_validate

limits.description: Concrete known limitations declared at the point of output

not_acceptance.description: true = exploratory output that must never be read as a certified result

provenance.description: Who/what produced this artifact, at which honesty tier, from which inputs. Skipped stages get an explicit omitted entry — an honest schema slot, never silence.
